operators.name: custom_upsample_bilinear2x
semantics: Equivalent to nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2.0, mode='bilinear', align_corners=False) on 4D input.
Output size is floor(input_size * scale_factor) for each spatial dim: [N, C, 2*H, 2*W].
For each output pixel (n,c,oh,ow), compute source coords: y=(oh+0.5)/2 - 0.5, x=(ow+0.5)/2 - 0.5.
Clamp y to [0,H-1], x to [0,W-1]; bilinear interpolate with y0=floor(y), y1=min(y0+1,H-1), x0=floor(x), x1=min(x0+1,W-1); weights wy1=y-y0, wx1=x-x0, wy0=1-wy1, wx0=1-wx1.

operators.name: custom_rot90
semantics: Equivalent to torch.rot90(input, k=k, dims=(dim0, dim1)).
For k=1, dim0=2, dim1=3, output[b,c,i,j] = input[b,c,j, H-1-i] where H=input.shape[2]=1024, W=input.shape[3]=256.
Only k=1 supported for this model; implementation handles k modulo 4.
Returns float32 CUDA tensor with shape [N, C, W, H] (swapped dims).
Bilinear upsampling with scale_factor=2.0 and align_corners=False.
Rotate last two dimensions clockwise by 90 degrees (k=1).
Final result is the rotated tensor.
